description: This file is an HTML webpage that contains embedded TCL code within a <textarea> element. It serves as documentation and an editor interface for the TCL mode in CodeMirror, a JavaScript-based code editor. The main content includes TCL script for a whois bot, along with CSS/JS dependencies for syntax highlighting and user interface.
